---------------------------- MODULE W4Od7m3p5t0 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES leader, epoch, crashed, token, effects
vars == <<leader, epoch, crashed, token, effects>>

None == "none"

TypeOK ==
  /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {None}
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ crashed \subseteq Nodes
  /\ token \in BOOLEAN
  /\ effects \in 0..2

Init ==
  /\ leader = None
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ crashed = {}
  /\ token = TRUE
  /\ effects = 0

Elect(n) ==
  /\ n \notin crashed
  /\ \/ leader = None
     \/ leader \in crashed
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<crashed, token, effects>>

Crash(n) ==
  /\ n \notin crashed
  /\ Cardinality(crashed) < 2
  /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, token, effects>>

Execute ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ leader \notin crashed
  /\ token = TRUE
  /\ token' = FALSE
  /\ effects' = effects + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, crashed>>

Failover ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ leader \in crashed
  /\ leader' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, crashed, token, effects>>

Idle ==
  /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes: Elect(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes: Crash(n)
  \/ Execute
  \/ Failover
  \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AtMostOnce ==
  /\ (token = TRUE) => (effects = 0)
  /\ (token = FALSE) => (effects = 1)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {n1, n2, n3}
    MaxEpoch = 3
INVARIANT AtMostOnce
nl:
Container-ship crane yard: three crane controllers (n1, n2, n3) coordinate the
single irreversible act of releasing a ship's emergency ballast, which can be
performed at most once per berthing. Controllers run a leader-election protocol
with failover: one live controller is elected leader for a monotonically
increasing epoch, and only the current live leader may trigger the ballast
release. A single controller may crash silently at any time without announcing
it. When the current leader is observed to have crashed, the yard performs a
failover that clears the leadership so a surviving controller can be elected in a
new epoch. The physical ballast mechanism is guarded by a one-shot permit: the
release action consumes the permit as it fires the physical effect, so a correct
protocol keeps the number of physical releases coherent with permit state.

Actions: Elect (a live controller becomes leader in a fresh epoch when there is
no live leader), Crash (a live controller crashes silently), Execute (the live
leader consumes the permit and performs the irreversible ballast release), and
Failover (clear a crashed leader so re-election can occur).

SAFETY PROPERTY: While the one-shot release permit is still available no physical ballast release has occurred, and once the permit is consumed exactly one release has occurred, so the irreversible action happens at most once.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m2p3t5 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Reqs, Slots, Parts

VARIABLES holds, phase, txReq, txSlot, yes
vars == <<holds, phase, txReq, txSlot, yes>>

NoneR == "none"
NoneS == "nil"

Free(s) == \A r \in Reqs : s \notin holds[r]

TypeOK ==
  /\ holds \in [Reqs -> SUBSET Slots]
  /\ phase \in {"idle", "voting"}
  /\ txReq \in Reqs \cup {NoneR}
  /\ txSlot \in Slots \cup {NoneS}
  /\ yes \subseteq Parts

Init ==
  /\ holds = [r \in Reqs |-> {}]
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ txReq = NoneR
  /\ txSlot = NoneS
  /\ yes = {}

Begin(r, s) ==
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ Free(s)
  /\ phase' = "voting"
  /\ txReq' = r
  /\ txSlot' = s
  /\ yes' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED holds

Vote(p) ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ p \notin yes
  /\ yes' = yes \cup {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holds, phase, txReq, txSlot>>

Commit ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ yes = Parts
  /\ Free(txSlot)
  /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![txReq] = @ \cup {txSlot}]
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ txReq' = NoneR
  /\ txSlot' = NoneS
  /\ yes' = {}

Abort ==
  /\ phase = "voting"
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ txReq' = NoneR
  /\ txSlot' = NoneS
  /\ yes' = {}
  /\ UNCHANGED holds

AdminOverride(r, s) ==
  /\ phase = "idle"
  /\ Free(s)
  /\ holds' = [holds EXCEPT ![r] = @ \cup {s}]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, txReq, txSlot, yes>>

Idle == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ \E r \in Reqs, s \in Slots : Begin(r, s)
  \/ \E p \in Parts : Vote(p)
  \/ Commit
  \/ Abort
  \/ \E r \in Reqs, s \in Slots : AdminOverride(r, s)
  \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAlloc ==
  \A r1, r2 \in Reqs : (r1 # r2) => (holds[r1] \cap holds[r2] = {})
=============================================================================
nl:
Blood-bank inventory tracker: a coordinator allocates cold-storage slots (s1, s2)
to pending blood-unit requests (r1, r2) using two-phase commit across participant
fridge controllers (p1, p2). To allocate a slot the coordinator opens a
transaction naming a requester and a currently-free slot, collects prepare votes
from every participant, and only then commits the grant so the requester takes
ownership of the slot. Transactions may also abort. A privileged admin can bypass
the voting round and grant a free slot directly. The critical correctness concern
is that a single physical slot is never handed to two different requests at the
same time.

Actions: Begin (open a transaction for a requester on a free slot), Vote (a
participant casts its prepare vote), Commit (with all votes in and the slot still
free, transfer ownership to the requester), Abort (cancel the current
transaction), AdminOverride (privileged direct grant of a free slot), and Idle.

SAFETY PROPERTY: No physical slot is ever simultaneously owned by two different requesters, i.e. the ownership sets of any two distinct requesters are disjoint.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m0p5t5 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Clients, MaxVer

VARIABLES ver, avail, readv, hasRead, dispensed, adminUsed
vars == <<ver, avail, readv, hasRead, dispensed, adminUsed>>

TypeOK ==
  /\ ver \in 0..MaxVer
  /\ avail \in BOOLEAN
  /\ readv \in [Clients -> 0..MaxVer]
  /\ hasRead \subseteq Clients
  /\ dispensed \in 0..2
  /\ adminUsed \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
  /\ ver = 0
  /\ avail = TRUE
  /\ readv = [c \in Clients |-> 0]
  /\ hasRead = {}
  /\ dispensed = 0
  /\ adminUsed = FALSE

Read(c) ==
  /\ c \notin hasRead
  /\ readv' = [readv EXCEPT ![c] = ver]
  /\ hasRead' = hasRead \cup {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, avail, dispensed, adminUsed>>

Commit(c) ==
  /\ c \in hasRead
  /\ avail = TRUE
  /\ readv[c] = ver
  /\ ver < MaxVer
  /\ dispensed' = dispensed + 1
  /\ avail' = FALSE
  /\ ver' = ver + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<readv, hasRead, adminUsed>>

Retry(c) ==
  /\ c \in hasRead
  /\ readv[c] # ver
  /\ readv' = [readv EXCEPT ![c] = ver]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<ver, avail, hasRead, dispensed, adminUsed>>

AdminOverride ==
  /\ avail = TRUE
  /\ adminUsed = FALSE
  /\ ver < MaxVer
  /\ dispensed' = dispensed + 1
  /\ avail' = FALSE
  /\ ver' = ver + 1
  /\ adminUsed' = TRUE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<readv, hasRead>>

Idle == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Clients : Read(c)
  \/ \E c \in Clients : Commit(c)
  \/ \E c \in Clients : Retry(c)
  \/ AdminOverride
  \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

DispenseOnce ==
  /\ dispensed <= 1
  /\ (avail = TRUE) => (dispensed = 0)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Clients = {c1, c2}
    MaxVer = 3
INVARIANT DispenseOnce
nl:
Vending machine network: two dispenser clients (c1, c2) compete to sell the last
unit of a product. The shared inventory record carries a version counter, and the
physical act of dispensing that final unit is irreversible and must happen at most
once. Clients use optimistic locking with retry: a client first reads the current
version, then tries to commit only if the version it read still matches the shared
version; a successful commit dispenses the unit and bumps the version. If a client
finds its read is stale it retries by re-reading the current version. A privileged
admin can force a single dispense of the available unit, bypassing the version
check but still respecting availability.

Actions: Read (an unread client records the current version), Commit (a client
whose read is still current dispenses the available unit and bumps the version),
Retry (a client whose read went stale re-reads the version), AdminOverride (a
one-time privileged forced dispense of the available unit), and Idle.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The irreversible dispense happens at most once: the physical dispense count never exceeds one, and while the unit is still available the count is zero.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m4p1t0 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS MaxId, Cap

VARIABLES queue, record, admitted, nextId, crashed
vars == <<queue, record, admitted, nextId, crashed>>

Ids == 1..MaxId
Queued == {queue[i] : i \in 1..Len(queue)}

TypeOK ==
  /\ queue \in Seq(Ids)
  /\ Len(queue) <= Cap
  /\ record \subseteq Ids
  /\ admitted \subseteq Ids
  /\ nextId \in 1..(MaxId + 1)
  /\ crashed \in BOOLEAN

Init ==
  /\ queue = << >>
  /\ record = {}
  /\ admitted = {}
  /\ nextId = 1
  /\ crashed = FALSE

Enqueue ==
  /\ Len(queue) < Cap
  /\ nextId <= MaxId
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, nextId)
  /\ admitted' = admitted \cup {nextId}
  /\ nextId' = nextId + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<record, crashed>>

Apply ==
  /\ crashed = FALSE
  /\ Len(queue) > 0
  /\ record' = record \cup {Head(queue)}
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<admitted, nextId, crashed>>

Crash ==
  /\ crashed = FALSE
  /\ crashed' = TRUE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, record, admitted, nextId>>

Recover ==
  /\ crashed = TRUE
  /\ crashed' = FALSE
  /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, record, admitted, nextId>>

Idle == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ Enqueue
  \/ Apply
  \/ Crash
  \/ Recover
  \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoLostUpdate ==
  admitted \subseteq (Queued \cup record)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    MaxId = 3
    Cap = 2
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
Print shop job spooler: submitting stations push page-count update jobs into a
bounded spool buffer that feeds a single worker which applies each update to the
shared accounting record. The buffer enforces backpressure: no new job is admitted
once the buffer is full. Every update that is admitted into the system carries a
unique id. The worker dequeues jobs in order and folds each one into the shared
record. The worker may crash silently at any moment, after which it applies
nothing until a standby recovers it; jobs already admitted simply wait in the
buffer meanwhile. The correctness concern is that no admitted update is ever lost:
each admitted update is always either still waiting in the buffer or already
reflected in the shared record.

Actions: Enqueue (admit a fresh update into the buffer while it has spare capacity),
Apply (a live worker dequeues the head job and records its update), Crash (the
worker fails silently), Recover (a standby restores the crashed worker), and Idle.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every admitted update is always still present in the buffer or already applied to the shared record, so no admitted update is ever lost.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od12m5p3t3 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Parts, Slots, Reqs, Quorum

VARIABLES choice, voted, owner, slow, allocated
vars == <<choice, voted, owner, slow, allocated>>

FreeS == "free"

Backers(s, r) == {p \in voted : choice[p] = <<s, r>>}
HasQuorum(s, r) == Cardinality(Backers(s, r)) >= Quorum

TypeOK ==
  /\ choice \in [Parts -> Slots \X Reqs]
  /\ voted \subseteq Parts
  /\ owner \in [Slots -> Reqs \cup {FreeS}]
  /\ slow \subseteq Parts
  /\ allocated \subseteq Slots

Init ==
  /\ choice = [p \in Parts |-> <<CHOOSE s \in Slots : TRUE, CHOOSE r \in Reqs : TRUE>>]
  /\ voted = {}
  /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> FreeS]
  /\ slow = {}
  /\ allocated = {}

Vote(p, s, r) ==
  /\ p \notin voted
  /\ p \notin slow
  /\ choice' = [choice EXCEPT ![p] = <<s, r>>]
  /\ voted' = voted \cup {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, slow, allocated>>

Delay(p) ==
  /\ p \notin voted
  /\ p \notin slow
  /\ slow' = slow \cup {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<choice, voted, owner, allocated>>

Wake(p) ==
  /\ p \in slow
  /\ slow' = slow \ {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<choice, voted, owner, allocated>>

Commit(s, r) ==
  /\ owner[s] = FreeS
  /\ HasQuorum(s, r)
  /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = r]
  /\ allocated' = allocated \cup {s}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<choice, voted, slow>>

Idle == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ \E p \in Parts, s \in Slots, r \in Reqs : Vote(p, s, r)
  \/ \E p \in Parts : Delay(p)
  \/ \E p \in Parts : Wake(p)
  \/ \E s \in Slots, r \in Reqs : Commit(s, r)
  \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

NoDoubleAlloc ==
  \A s \in Slots : \A r1, r2 \in Reqs :
    (HasQuorum(s, r1) /\ HasQuorum(s, r2)) => (r1 = r2)
=============================================================================
nl:
Blood-bank inventory tracker with quorum voting: cold-storage slots (s1, s2) are
allocated to blood-unit requests (r1, r2) by a committee of three participant
controllers (p1, p2, p3). Each participant casts at most one vote, naming the one
slot-and-request pair it endorses. A slot is committed to a request only once that
pair has collected a quorum of two votes. A participant may be slow: it can be
marked as delayed and abstain for a while before later being woken to vote, but it
never fails outright. Because every participant votes only once and a quorum is a
strict majority of the three, two different requests can never both gather a quorum
for the same slot, which is what prevents the same slot being allocated twice.

Actions: Vote (a non-slow participant that has not yet voted endorses a slot-request
pair), Delay (mark a not-yet-voted participant as slow), Wake (clear a slow
participant so it may vote), Commit (bind a slot to a request once that pair holds a
quorum and the slot is free), and Idle.

SAFETY PROPERTY: For any slot, two distinct requests can never both hold a voting quorum, so the same slot is never double-allocated.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od6m0p2t4 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Locs, Elevs, Total, MaxVer, MaxCap

VARIABLES load, ver, capE, mv
vars == <<load, ver, capE, mv>>

RECURSIVE SumF(_, _)
SumF(f, S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
              ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumF(f, S \ {x})

TypeOK ==
  /\ load \in [Locs -> 0..Total]
  /\ ver \in [Locs -> 0..MaxVer]
  /\ capE \in 1..MaxCap
  /\ mv \in [src : Locs, dst : Locs, rs : 0..MaxVer, rd : 0..MaxVer, on : BOOLEAN]

DefLoc == CHOOSE l \in Locs : TRUE

Init ==
  /\ load \in {f \in [Locs -> 0..Total] : SumF(f, Locs) = Total}
  /\ ver = [l \in Locs |-> 0]
  /\ capE = MaxCap
  /\ mv = [src |-> DefLoc, dst |-> DefLoc, rs |-> 0, rd |-> 0, on |-> FALSE]

StartMove(s, d) ==
  /\ mv.on = FALSE
  /\ s # d
  /\ load[s] > 0
  /\ mv' = [src |-> s, dst |-> d, rs |-> ver[s], rd |-> ver[d], on |-> TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, ver, capE>>

CommitMove ==
  /\ mv.on = TRUE
  /\ ver[mv.src] = mv.rs
  /\ ver[mv.dst] = mv.rd
  /\ ver[mv.src] < MaxVer
  /\ ver[mv.dst] < MaxVer
  /\ (mv.dst \in Elevs) => (load[mv.dst] < capE)
  /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![mv.src] = @ - 1, ![mv.dst] = @ + 1]
  /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![mv.src] = @ + 1, ![mv.dst] = @ + 1]
  /\ mv' = [mv EXCEPT !.on = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED capE

RetryMove ==
  /\ mv.on = TRUE
  /\ \/ ver[mv.src] # mv.rs
     \/ ver[mv.dst] # mv.rd
  /\ mv' = [mv EXCEPT !.rs = ver[mv.src], !.rd = ver[mv.dst]]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, ver, capE>>

Touch(l) ==
  /\ ver[l] < MaxVer
  /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![l] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, capE, mv>>

ChangeCap(c) ==
  /\ capE' = c
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, ver, mv>>

Idle == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ \E s, d \in Locs : StartMove(s, d)
  \/ CommitMove
  \/ RetryMove
  \/ \E l \in Locs : Touch(l)
  \/ \E c \in 1..MaxCap : ChangeCap(c)
  \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conservation == SumF(load, Locs) = Total
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Locs = {f1, f2, e1}
    Elevs = {e1}
    Total = 2
    MaxVer = 2
    MaxCap = 2
INVARIANT Conservation
nl:
Elevator bank in a skyscraper: passengers occupy locations that are either landing
floors (f1, f2) or the elevator car (e1). Passengers are neither created nor
destroyed; the total headcount across all locations is fixed. To move a passenger
between locations the controller uses optimistic locking with retry: it records the
version stamps of the source and destination location, and only commits the move if
both stamps still match what it read, decrementing the source and incrementing the
destination together and bumping both versions. An external status refresh may touch
a location and bump its version, which makes an in-flight move stale so it must
re-read and retry. The elevator's capacity can change at runtime; a move into the
car is only committed while the car is below its current capacity.

Actions: StartMove (record source and destination versions for a passenger move),
CommitMove (atomically transfer one passenger when versions still match and capacity
permits), RetryMove (re-read versions when a stamp changed underneath the move),
Touch (an external refresh bumps a location's version), ChangeCap (reset the car's
capacity), and Idle.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of passengers summed over all locations always equals the fixed headcount, so no passenger is ever created or destroyed.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od17m6p6t3 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Nodes, MaxClock, MaxEpoch, LeaseLen

VARIABLES owner, epoch, expiry, clock, stamp, epochOwner
vars == <<owner, epoch, expiry, clock, stamp, epochOwner>>

None == "none"

TypeOK ==
  /\ owner \in Nodes \cup {None}
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ expiry \in 0..(MaxClock + LeaseLen)
  /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
  /\ stamp \in [ep : 0..MaxEpoch, by : Nodes \cup {None}]
  /\ epochOwner \in [0..MaxEpoch -> Nodes \cup {None}]

Init ==
  /\ owner = None
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ expiry = 0
  /\ clock = 0
  /\ stamp = [ep |-> 0, by |-> None]
  /\ epochOwner = [e \in 0..MaxEpoch |-> None]

GrantLease(n) ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ \/ owner = None
     \/ clock > expiry
  /\ owner' = n
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ expiry' = clock + LeaseLen
  /\ epochOwner' = [epochOwner EXCEPT ![epoch + 1] = n]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, stamp>>

Tick ==
  /\ clock < MaxClock
  /\ clock' = clock + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, epoch, expiry, stamp, epochOwner>>

Act(n) ==
  /\ owner = n
  /\ clock <= expiry
  /\ stamp' = [ep |-> epoch, by |-> n]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<owner, epoch, expiry, clock, epochOwner>>

Release(n) ==
  /\ owner = n
  /\ owner' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<epoch, expiry, clock, stamp, epochOwner>>

Idle == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : GrantLease(n)
  \/ Tick
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Act(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Release(n)
  \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

AuthorizedOnly ==
  /\ stamp.ep <= epoch
  /\ (stamp.by # None) => (stamp.by = epochOwner[stamp.ep])
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {n1, n2}
    MaxClock = 3
    MaxEpoch = 3
    LeaseLen = 2
INVARIANT AuthorizedOnly
nl:
Airport baggage router: a conveyor junction is controlled by one router node at a
time under a lease with an expiry. A node acquires the lease when the junction is
free or the previous lease has expired; each new lease carries a fresh, strictly
increasing epoch (a fencing token) and an expiry deadline measured against a shared
clock. Only the node currently holding an unexpired lease may perform a routing
action, and each routing action stamps the junction with the acting node and the
epoch under which it acted. A node can be slow: time may advance and its lease may
lapse or be superseded by a newer epoch before it gets to act, and in that case it
is no longer authorized. The junction must never record a routing action by a node
that is not the current valid lease holder.

Actions: GrantLease (a node takes a free or expired lease under a new epoch),
Tick (advance the shared clock, possibly expiring a lease), Act (the current
unexpired lease holder routes a bag and stamps its epoch and identity), Release
(the holder relinquishes its lease), and Idle.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The stamped epoch never exceeds the current epoch, and whenever the stamp is at the current epoch its recorded actor is the current lease holder, so no unauthorized or stale node ever acts.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m6p0t2 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Nodes, InstA, MaxClock, LeaseLen

VARIABLES holder, expiry, clock, inCS, holderInst
vars == <<holder, expiry, clock, inCS, holderInst>>

None == "none"
Inst(n) == IF n \in InstA THEN "A" ELSE "B"

TypeOK ==
  /\ holder \in Nodes \cup {None}
  /\ expiry \in 0..(MaxClock + LeaseLen)
  /\ clock \in 0..MaxClock
  /\ inCS \subseteq Nodes
  /\ holderInst \in {"A", "B", None}

Init ==
  /\ holder = None
  /\ expiry = 0
  /\ clock = 0
  /\ inCS = {}
  /\ holderInst = None

Acquire(n) ==
  /\ holder = None
  /\ holder' = n
  /\ holderInst' = Inst(n)
  /\ expiry' = clock + LeaseLen
  /\ UNCHANGED <<clock, inCS>>

Renew(n) ==
  /\ holder = n
  /\ expiry' = clock + LeaseLen
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, clock, inCS, holderInst>>

Enter(n) ==
  /\ holder = n
  /\ n \notin inCS
  /\ inCS' = inCS \cup {n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, clock, holderInst>>

Exit(n) ==
  /\ n \in inCS
  /\ inCS' = inCS \ {n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, clock, holderInst>>

Expire ==
  /\ holder # None
  /\ clock > expiry
  /\ inCS = {}
  /\ holder' = None
  /\ holderInst' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<expiry, clock, inCS>>

Tick ==
  /\ clock < MaxClock
  /\ clock' = clock + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED <<holder, expiry, inCS, holderInst>>

Idle == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Acquire(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Renew(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Enter(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Exit(n)
  \/ Expire
  \/ Tick
  \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

MutualExclusion == \A n \in inCS : n = holder
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
SPECIFICATION Spec
CONSTANTS
    Nodes = {a1, a2, b1}
    InstA = {a1, a2}
    MaxClock = 3
    LeaseLen = 2
INVARIANT MutualExclusion
nl:
Multiplayer game lobby matchmaker: two independent matchmaker instances (instance
A with workers a1, a2 and instance B with worker b1) draw from one shared pool and
must take turns using a single critical resource, the active match-formation slot.
Access is governed by a lease with an expiry against a shared clock. A worker
acquires the lease only when it is free, may renew it to extend the expiry, and may
enter the critical section only while it holds the lease. A held lease can only be
reclaimed (expired) once its holder is no longer inside the critical section, which
prevents the slot from being handed to another instance while someone is still
using it.

Actions: Acquire (a worker takes the free lease and records its instance), Renew
(the holder extends its expiry), Enter (the lease holder enters the critical
section), Exit (a worker leaves the critical section), Expire (reclaim an expired
lease whose holder has already left), Tick (advance the shared clock), and Idle.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every worker inside the critical section is the current lease holder, so at most one worker across both instances is ever in the critical section at a time.

---------------------------- MODULE W4Od6m2p1t1 ----------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Updates, Parts

VARIABLES votes, decided, record, msgs
vars == <<votes, decided, record, msgs>>

TypeOK ==

  /\ decided \in [Updates -> {"none", "commit", "abort"}]

  /\ record = {}
  /\ msgs = {}

  /\ votes[u] = Parts

  /\ msgs' = msgs \cup {<<u, "apply">>}

  /\ decided' = [decided EXCEPT ![u] = "abort"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, record, msgs>>

  /\ record' = record \cup {u}
  /\ msgs' = msgs \ {<<u, "apply">>}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<votes, decided>>

update the coordinator gathers yes-votes from the participants; once every
participant has voted yes it decides commit and emits an apply message. A
participant applies a committed update to the shared record when it receives the
corresponding apply message, which may arrive late or out of order. An update may
instead be aborted before it is decided. The correctness concern is that no
committed update is ever lost.

nl:
Hospital operating-room scheduler: writer clients (w1, w2) revise the shared
operating-room schedule record, which carries a version counter. Each writer uses
optimistic locking with retry: it first reads the current version, then attempts to
commit its revision only if the version it read still matches the live version. A
successful commit bumps the version and emits an apply message that folds the
writer's revision into the record; because the network reorders messages, apply
messages are held in an unordered in-flight set and may be folded in any order. If a
writer discovers its read has gone stale it abandons the attempt and retries from a
fresh read. This is exactly what stops a stale writer from silently overwriting and
losing another writer's committed revision.

read is still current bumps the version and puts its apply message in flight),
Retry (a writer whose read went stale returns to re-read), Apply (fold an in-flight
apply message into the shared record), and Idle.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Every writer that has committed either already has its revision folded into the record or still has its apply message in flight, so no committed revision is ever lost.

nl:
Air-traffic runway allocator: approaching-flight controllers (c1, c2) contend for a
single runway represented by a compare-and-swap register that is either free, held
by one controller, or spent. Granting a flight its takeoff clearance is irreversible
and must happen at most once per runway cycle. A controller first requests the
runway, then performs a CAS that succeeds only when the register is free, taking
ownership. The owner then issues the one irreversible takeoff clearance, which
consumes the register by moving it to the spent state so no further CAS or clearance
can occur. A controller may be slow: it can be marked delayed and skip acting for a
while before being woken, but it never fails.

controller slow), Wake (clear a controller's slow mark), CAS (a requesting
controller swaps the free register to take ownership), Clear (the owner issues the
irreversible clearance and spends the register), and Idle.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The takeoff-clearance count never exceeds one and is one exactly when the register is spent and a winner is recorded, so the irreversible clearance happens at most once.

    MaxId = 3
    Cap = 2

nl:
Airport baggage router: scanning stations feed routing-table update jobs into a
bounded spool buffer that a router drains into the shared routing table. Normal
enqueues honor backpressure and are refused once the buffer is full. Every update
accepted into the system carries a unique id. A privileged admin has two override
powers: it may jump an update onto the front of the buffer even past the
backpressure limit, or it may force an update straight into the routing table,
skipping the buffer entirely. The router drains the buffer head-first into the
table. The correctness concern is that no accepted update is ever lost: the set of
accepted updates is always exactly those still buffered plus those already in the
table.

AdminJump (privileged front-insert that bypasses backpressure), Apply (drain the
buffer head into the routing table), AdminForce (privileged direct insert into the
table), and Idle.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The set of accepted updates always equals exactly the updates currently in the buffer together with those already in the routing table, so no accepted update is ever lost or duplicated.

nl:
Elevator bank control channel: two controllers (x1, x2) contend for exclusive use
of the elevator's door-control channel, the critical resource, guarded by a
compare-and-swap lock register that is either free or held by one controller. A
controller registers interest, then performs a CAS that succeeds only when the lock
is free, taking ownership. Only the lock owner may enter the control critical
section, and only when the elevator's capacity is currently at least one (the
capacity can be changed at runtime, and dropping it to zero takes the car out of

critical section. Entering the critical section is bounded by an operation budget.

controller CAS-takes the free lock), Enter (the lock owner enters the control

nl:
Stock exchange opening auction: the auction engine goes through epoch-numbered
reconfigurations, each installing a fresh coordinator (from s1, s2) under a strictly
increasing configuration epoch. The single irreversible action is running the
opening cross, the batch that matches all opening orders and prints the opening
price; it must fire at most once across all reconfigurations. Only the current live
coordinator of the active epoch may run the cross, and it stamps the epoch in which
it fired. One participant may crash silently at any time; a crashed coordinator is
later detected and cleared, triggering a reconfiguration to a new epoch and a
surviving coordinator.

there is no live coordinator), Crash (a participant crashes silently, at most one),
RunCross (the live active coordinator fires the one-shot opening cross and records
its epoch), Failover (clear a crashed coordinator), and Idle.

SAFETY PROPERTY: Any two distinct trains that are on a block are on different blocks, so no track block is ever occupied by two trains at once.

--------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m3p2t2 ---------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Nodes, InstA, Queues, Total, MaxEpoch

VARIABLES load, leader, epoch, down, leaderInst
vars == <<load, leader, epoch, down, leaderInst>>

None == "none"
Inst(n) == IF n \in InstA THEN "A" ELSE "B"

RECURSIVE SumF(_, _)
SumF(f, S) == IF S = {} THEN 0
              ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN f[x] + SumF(f, S \ {x})

TypeOK ==
  /\ load \in [Queues -> 0..Total]
  /\ leader \in Nodes \cup {None}
  /\ epoch \in 0..MaxEpoch
  /\ down \subseteq Nodes
  /\ leaderInst \in {"A", "B", None}

Init ==
  /\ load \in {f \in [Queues -> 0..Total] : SumF(f, Queues) = Total}
  /\ leader = None
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ down = {}
  /\ leaderInst = None

Elect(n) ==
  /\ n \notin down
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ \/ leader = None
     \/ leader \in down
  /\ leader' = n
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ leaderInst' = Inst(n)
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, down>>

Fail(n) ==
  /\ leader = n
  /\ Cardinality(down) < 2
  /\ down' = down \cup {n}
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, leader, epoch, leaderInst>>

Failover ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ leader \in down
  /\ leader' = None
  /\ leaderInst' = None
  /\ UNCHANGED <<load, epoch, down>>

Transfer(s, d) ==
  /\ leader # None
  /\ leader \notin down
  /\ s # d
  /\ load[s] > 0
  /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![s] = @ - 1, ![d] = @ + 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, epoch, down, leaderInst>>

Idle == UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
  \/ \E n \in Nodes : Fail(n)
  \/ Failover
  \/ \E s, d \in Queues : Transfer(s, d)
  \/ Idle

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Conservation == SumF(load, Queues) = Total
=============================================================================
nl:
Print shop job spooler shared by two independent instances (instance A with nodes a1,
a2 and instance B with node b1) drawing from one common pool. Print jobs sit in queues
(q1, q2), and the total number of jobs is conserved - jobs are only moved between
queues, never created or destroyed. Only the currently elected leader may transfer a
job from one queue to another. Leadership is decided by election with failover: when
the post is vacant a live node is elected under a strictly increasing epoch, a leader
may fail, and a failed leader is detected and cleared so a survivor (possibly from the
other instance) can be elected.

Actions: Elect (elect a live node as leader under the next epoch when the post is
vacant), Fail (the current leader fails), Failover (clear a failed leader), Transfer
(the live leader moves one job from a non-empty source queue to another queue), and
Idle.

SAFETY PROPERTY: The total number of jobs summed over all queues always equals the fixed pool size, so no job is ever created or destroyed.
